note: COBOL intrinsic FUNCTIONs that gnucobol-rs's front-end does NOT yet wire. gnucobol-rs wires 82/110 intrinsics, each proven byte-identical to the admitted GnuCOBOL 3.2 cobc; these 28 are the boundary. Each was probed against the oracle to classify it honestly (not a blanket 'no oracle'): some are absent/inactive in 3.2 (no oracle behaviour), others are concrete future targets needing a sealed runtime helper or more front-end modelling. Recorded as a build plan for a SEPARATE kobold-side layer. DATA ONLY: no gnucobol/libcob GPL source. Companion to frontend-boundary-verbs-build-plan.json.
